d:
''Rang darungi Nand ke lalan pe' - a timeless proclamation that reflects Uttar Pradesh’s spirit of Holi. fuses classic Awadhi folk music with groovy modern beats, and is performed by , & Prateeksha Srivastava.
CREDITS
Composer: Vishal Mishra
Singer: Vishal Mishra, Malini Awasthi, Prateeksha Srivastava
Music Arrangement: Vishal Mishra
Lyrics: Vishal Mishra, Kaushal Kishore
Music Production: Vishal Mishra, Vaibhav Pani, Bitupon Boruah, Kandarpa Kalita, Trihangku Lahkar
Kathak dance : Shinjini Kulkarni
